subject: User-defined function called in parameter constraint  --- compilation error

messages.author: a7de39e424b27378
messages.subject: User-defined function called in parameter constraint  --- compilation error
parts:
Dear Stan community,

I am using a convoluted function to determine my parameter constraints; when compiling, I get an error.
(I am using PyStan, but the code did not work in CmdStan either.) I am new to Stan - sorry if my question
was already answered, but I could not find the answer.

Here is my Python script (CmdStan script and CmdStan error below):
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
code = """
functions {
    real value_1() {
        return 0;
    }
}

parameters {
    real<lower=value_1(),upper=1> y;
}

model {
    // Use the default
    // y ~ uniform(0,1);
}  
"""

fit = pystan.stan(model_code=code, iter=10000, chains=4)
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Here is the error message:
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
INFO:pystan:COMPILING THE C++ CODE FOR MODEL anon_model_3c1842d2ad22a9e430bc4388758c5e59 NOW.
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "<stdin>", line 1, in <module>
  File "sandbox/gen_code.stan", line 17, in <module>
    fit = pystan.stan(model_code=code, iter=10000, chains=4)
  File "../local/lib/python2.7/site-packages/pystan-2.5.0.0-py2.7-linux-x86_64.egg/pystan/api.py", line 370, in stan
    save_dso=save_dso, verbose=verbose)
  File "../local/lib/python2.7/site-packages/pystan-2.5.0.0-py2.7-linux-x86_64.egg/pystan/model.py", line 305, in __init__
    build_extension.run()
  File "/usr/lib/python2.7/distutils/command/build_ext.py", line 337, in run
    self.build_extensions()
  File "/usr/lib/python2.7/distutils/command/build_ext.py", line 446, in build_extensions
    self.build_extension(ext)
  File "/usr/lib/python2.7/distutils/command/build_ext.py", line 496, in build_extension
    depends=ext.depends)
  File "/usr/lib/python2.7/distutils/ccompiler.py", line 574, in compile
    self._compile(obj, src, ext, cc_args, extra_postargs, pp_opts)
  File "/usr/lib/python2.7/distutils/unixccompiler.py", line 122, in _compile
    raise CompileError, msg
distutils.errors.CompileError: command 'x86_64-linux-gnu-gcc' failed with exit status 1
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


CmdStan script (file is saved as 'gen_code.stan'):
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
functions {
    real value_1() {
        return 0;
    }
}

data {
     // Not present
}
parameters {
    real<lower=value_1(),upper=1> y;
}
model {
    //Use the default
    //y ~ uniform(0,1);
}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

CmdStan error message:
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- Translating Stan model to C++ code ---
bin/stanc sandbox/gen_code.stan --o=sandbox/gen_code.cpp --no_main
Model name=gen_code_model
Input file=sandbox/gen_code.stan
Output file=sandbox/gen_code.cpp

--- Linking C++ model ---
g++ -DBOOST_RESULT_OF_USE_TR1 -DBOOST_NO_DECLTYPE -DBOOST_DISABLE_ASSERTS -I src -I stan/src -isystem stan/lib/eigen_3.2.0 -isystem stan/lib/boost_1.54.0 -Wall -pipe -DEIGEN_NO_DEBUG -Wno-unused-local-typedefs  -lpthread  -O3 -o sandbox/gen_code src/cmdstan/main.cpp -include sandbox/gen_code.cpp -Lbin -lstan
In file included from <command-line>:0:0:
./sandbox/gen_code.cpp: In member function ‘void gen_code_model_namespace::gen_code_model::transform_inits(const stan::io::var_context&, std::vector<int>&, std::vector<double>&) const’:
./sandbox/gen_code.cpp:85:55: error: ‘pstream__’ was not declared in this scope
         try { writer__.scalar_lub_unconstrain(value_1(pstream__),1,y); } catch (const std::exception& e) {  throw std::runtime_error(std::string("Error transforming variable y: ") + e.what()); }
                                                       ^
In file included from stan/src/stan/agrad/rev/operators/operator_unary_plus.hpp:7:0,
                 from stan/src/stan/agrad/rev/operators.hpp:22,
                 from stan/src/stan/agrad/rev.hpp:13,
                 from stan/src/stan/model/model_header.hpp:16,
                 from ./sandbox/gen_code.cpp:3,
                 from <command-line>:0:
stan/src/stan/math/constants.hpp: At global scope:
stan/src/stan/math/constants.hpp:63:18: warning: ‘stan::math::NEGATIVE_EPSILON’ defined but not used [-Wunused-variable]
     const double NEGATIVE_EPSILON = - std::numeric_limits<double>::epsilon();
                  ^
make: *** [sandbox/gen_code] Error 1
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



What am I doing wrong? Thanks in advance,

Regards,
Arseniy.

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] User-defined function called in parameter constraint ---  compilation error
parts:
Thanks for the report and simple reproducible example. It's definitely
a bug --- if a Stan program can be translated to C++, it should compile
in C++. I created an issue to fix it and assigned it to myself with
priority for the next release:

https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/issues/1151

Shouldn't be a problem to fix.

- Bob
